english.note: Use this when someone yields or surrenders to overwhelming force, pressure, or an opponent.

examples.english: Under sustained military pressure, the defending forces were eventually forced to succumb.
examples.traditional: 面對持續嘅軍事壓力，守軍最後被迫屈服。
